summary: Market mood is cautiously risk-on in crypto, with Degen Dave highlighting several altcoin setups and Bloomberg flagging that crypto funds are still under pressure from the recent rout. The clearest fresh bullish themes today are AI/altcoin narratives, while Bitcoin remains pivotal around support/resistance and macro assets are mixed.
